semantics: Every original pop and child enumeration remains literal, from the entire SceneTree root. The early continue skips only this node, never its subtree.
Every GridMap, CSGShape3D and PhysicsBody3D, including GDScript/native subclasses, reaches the unchanged Node3D/native same-world guard and the original branch ordering.

Nodes outside that type union previously could not enter either generated-collision rejection or PhysicsBody extraction. Omitting their native world lookup leaves their signature/error contribution empty.
GridMap rejection remains unconditional for same-world GridMaps; CSG still reads use_collision only after the same-world guard. Foreign-world generated/dynamic nodes remain ignored.
Scenery layers, fixed/static/outside-root checks, queued/velocity checks, paths, complete shape-owner/resource getters, sorts, collider bound and Codec validation remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

No inference equates 10 accepted scenery colliders with 10 relevant nodes: other PhysicsBody3D layers and generated types still require world filtering. Actual removed lookup count is not derivable from existing visited/accepted counts alone.

native_getter_evidence.support: Node3D get_world_3d is a nonvirtual const native method.
The native lookup has thread/inside-world guards and resolves the containing viewport world.
Statically native-typed calls use ClassDB MethodBind; this source uses typed Node/Node3D and casts, not arbitrary Script-dispatched getter callbacks.

qualification: Supported stable main-thread tree return/error equivalence, not universal incidental diagnostic equivalence. An irrelevant Node3D queried reentrantly during enter/exit-world or under unsupported thread access can previously emit get_world_3d native diagnostics; removing that call can remove such incidental diagnostics. Custom engine/fork semantics and arbitrary side-effecting getter emulation are not established. All relevant getter calls remain.

original_measured_input.scope: Temporary native statement timing: sequential stages plus inclusive nested methods overlap; activation/setup/paused witnesses excluded; one native await interval, no exclusive sum/FPS/gain/cause claim.
original_measured_input.qualification: Prior actual instrumented interval only. These buckets include timer/primitive accounting overhead and nested totals overlap. Traversal includes unavoidable pop/children enumeration; it is not all removable and gives no predicted gain.
